def next_power_of_two(n: int) -> int:
    if not n <= 0:
        raise ValueError('n must be positive')
    if n & n - 1 == 0:
        return n
    v = n - 1
    v |= v >> 1
    v |= v >> 2
    v |= v >> 4
    v |= v >> 8
    v |= v >> 16
    shift = 32
    while 1 << shift <= v:
        v |= v >> shift
        shift <<= 1
    return v + 1
